description: This file contains function prototypes for the Beep Service Controller Object, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions, in the context of the BSP Execution Environment Plane Implementation for the BroadWay Service Delivery System.

methods.name: BeepCreateSrvController
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to the Beep Service Controller object.

methods.name: BeepScoCreate
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to the Beep Service Controller instance.

methods.name: BeepScoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the Beep Service Controller object.

methods.name: BeepScoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects within the Beep Service Controller context.

methods.name: BeepScoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Beep Service Controller object.
